title: AIMS connector
description: Blueprint section 9.14: the typed work-order row shape of 9.4 as a read-only AIMS connector would exchange it, watermark on report date, closeout completeness computed on arrival; the connector panel and GET /api/connectors/:name/schema serve this file byte for byte.
x-sync: watermark on report date; closeout completeness computed on arrival
x-conflict-rule: the system of record wins on typed fields
x-failure-behaviour: the register is not recomputed on a failed sync

AimsWorkOrderRow.title: AimsWorkOrderRow
AimsWorkOrderRow.description: The typed work-order row shape of 9.4 (WorkOrder), reused by reference. The watermark is report_date; closeout_complete and completeness_flags are computed on arrival from the eleven outcome fields, not supplied by the system of record; the system of record wins on typed fields; the register is not recomputed on a failed sync.
